newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA sees Keno Nevada approval soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA sees Keno Nevada approval soon.

text.p: Electronics and gaming operator AWA Ltd said on Wednesday it expected to shortly receive approval from the Nevada gaming board for its Club Keno game to be operated through the U.S. state.

AWA chairman told the annual meeting that the group had recently completed a networked trial of Club Keno, which is an on-line game based on a 3,000-year-old Chinese gambling game, in cooperation with Circus Circus Enterprises.
"We understand we will shortly receive Nevada Gaming Board approval which will enable our licensee to operate networked Keno in casinos throughout the state," Iliffe said.
Iliffe said AWA has already received a software licensing fee and will receive an ongoing income.
He said AWA has also signed an agreement to introduce and manage Keno in casinos in the Philippines, the first networked Keno game to be licensed by the Philippines government.
Operations are expected to begin before the end of June 1997 and AWA will receive a percentage of turnover, Iliffe said.
He said AWA and the Greek lottery company has been selected by the Greek racing authority as preferred tenderer to supply and install a new on-course and off-course totalisator system in Athens.
